[[Unidentified Miskara (Jorj Car'das)|The Miskara]] owned a '''warship'''. The [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the species' [[Vagaari slaver fleet|fleet]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Miskara's warship appeared in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
